in_hindi.name: लालबहादुर
in_hindi.meaning: बहुमूल्य (बहादुर) - भाग्यवति (लाल) [शक्ति] बहुमूल्य रक्षाकर्ता (प्रतिवादी) [शक्ति] शूरवेर (शूर) [शक्ति] हेरो (hero) [English]
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bahumool (Bahadur) - Bhagvati (Lal) [Shakti] Bahumooly Rakshakarta (Pratividhi) [Shakti] Shoorveer (Shoor) [Shakti] Hero [English] - Great protector (Bahadur) - Fortune (Lal) [Shakti] - Powerful defender (Pratividhi) [Shakti] - Brave warrior (Shoor) [Shakti] - Hero [English]

in_marathi.name: Lalbahadur
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Red Lotus God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalbahadur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lalbahadur is a compound name derived from Sanskrit. Lal refers to red and bahadur means god or hero. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted with a red lingam (phallic symbol).
